title: Anthropic tells investors Claude Mythos Preview got its AI running on AMD GPUs in ~3 days with "basically no human intervention", vs. the usual 6-12 months (Shane Downing/Tom's Hardware)
summary: Shane Downing / Tom's Hardware: Anthropic tells investors Claude Mythos Preview got its AI running on AMD GPUs in ~3 days with “basically no human intervention”, vs. the usual 6-12 months — If AI can write the low-level code that ties models to Nvidia, CUDA matters less.
